items.headline: FMRB executive order amicus coalition broadens; May 15 briefing locks in
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday the AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice opened the Section 708 / APA challenge with a joint open letter, and Senators Warner and Young requested a classified threshold briefing. Today the Knight First Amendment Institute and EFF file a Saturday amicus letter joining the coalition, sharpening the demand to a 60-day public comment window plus a documented State Farm reasoned-decision record. Senator Rosen joins the requesting cohort and the May 15 briefing is firmed at 14:00 EDT in S-407 with NIST Director Locascio, ODNI cyber lead, and a CISA JCDC representative. OSTP signals via Saturday press-pool note that no signing window opens before May 22.

items.headline: Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter adds South Korea and New Zealand candidates
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Singapore IMDA and Japan AISI signed the parallel cyber-eval reciprocity memorandum, with Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC pre-committing as observers — a four-jurisdiction perimeter inside one news cycle. Today South Korea's PIPC and Ministry of Science and ICT publish a joint Saturday statement signaling intent to mirror the MoC under a 90-day domestic-consultation window with formal signature targeted for July, and New Zealand's GCSB confirms it will join as observer with a Q3 2026 mirror commitment. The seventh-jurisdiction shape that the May 8 prediction window flagged now has named candidates. The US recognition gap widens by one weekend.

items.headline: Tenstorrent files confidential S-1; SambaNova picks JPMorgan and Citi as co-bookrunners
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday's accelerator-IPO cohort coverage closed with Tenstorrent confirming the $3.4B IPO bridge round closed Wednesday and a confidential S-1 targeted for July. Today Tenstorrent files the confidential S-1 draft with the SEC late Friday after market close (publicly disclosed Saturday) under the JOBS Act EGC framework, with public window opening early August and Hyundai plus Samsung Foundry retaining co-anchor positions. SambaNova separately confirms J.P. Morgan and Citi as joint lead bookrunners alongside Goldman for an S-1 confidential submission targeted for late June at a $7-9B fully-diluted range. Groq remains 30-60 days behind SambaNova pending sovereign-cloud Saudi terms closure. The CBRS first-day pop reads as reference rather than hurdle for the cohort.

items.headline: Cerebras CBRS post-trade reflection: Bernstein adds Market-Perform; lock-up firmed
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday CBRS opened at $151.40 (+18.3% over IPO) and closed near $148, with Morgan Stanley, Goldman, and Citi initiating Buy at $165-$185 targets. Today Bernstein adds a Market-Perform initiation at $172 citing Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency as the top single-counterparty concentration risk; existing Buy initiations hold. Cerebras CFO confirms in a Saturday investor-Q&A note that the 180-day lock-up expires October 28, 2026 with no early-release waiver contemplated for the OpenAI $1B warrant package. SEC Corp Fin's Saturday-edition footnote clarifies the May 8 Mag-7 sample comment letter is generally applicable guidance, not a Wells-style enforcement signal — Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, and Evercore ISI lift their probability of recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence becoming the operative norm.

items.headline: Ni8mare day-nine scan: exposed instances drop to ~6,800; weekend exploitation taper
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday's day-eight scan dropped exposed pre-1.121.0 n8n instances from ~14,200 to ~8,300 (-41.5%) post-KEV listing with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike. Today Shadowserver's day-nine scan continues the descent to ~6,800 (-18.1% in 24 hours), with the German cohort falling below the four-figure mark for the first time (980 to 740). 44% of residual instances remain unpatched, mostly clustered in self-hosted Docker rather than n8n Cloud. Censys honeypot telemetry shows the 4.8x spike taper to ~2.9x baseline, consistent with weekend commodity exploit-kit throttling. CISA reiterates the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline; NHS England's agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist holds.

items.headline: Microsoft Defender MCP module quarantine rate climbs to 24%; identity gateway scales
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday the third weekly MCP-server attack-surface telemetry placed exposed servers at ~10,400 with 19% of net-new servers on Defender-protected estates quarantined within 30 minutes. Today Microsoft publishes a weekend supplemental note documenting the quarantine rate has climbed to 24%. Cisco-Astrix MCP-server identity gateway (co-branded with Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger) hits 740 enterprise-tenant deployments in its first 48 hours of availability. Sysdig adds a weekend addendum showing median time-from-MCP-server-provisioning to first credential-extraction attempt has fallen to 19 minutes on unprotected estates versus 4.3 hours on Defender-protected tenants. Cross-vendor control-plane visibility now exceeds 65% of new MCP-server provisioning events.

items.headline: Claude Code 3.0 day-two telemetry: 13,800 skills, 22 Mythos quarantines, 41 gated tenants
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Anthropic's day-one telemetry counted 11,400 skills published, 612K installs, 14 Mythos-class auto-quarantines, and 38 enterprise tenants opted into Mythos Preview gating under the contractual ethics-and-misuse rider. Today the day-two consolidation lifts published skills to 13,800 (+21%) and installs to 891K across the second 24 hours. Auto-quarantines climb to 22, with 8 originating from JPMorgan Chase, Booz Allen Hamilton, and Mandiant Consulting tenants. Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 sign the contractual rider over the weekend, lifting the gated cohort to 41. Simon Willison's Saturday follow-up praises the per-tenant attestation log shape as the first vendor-side governance primitive that holds up to a sustained audit-trail review.

items.headline: Hyperscaler registry interop extends: Microsoft adds Anthropic preview, AWS adds OpenAI; Mistral lands DGFiP
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog, AWS Bedrock Agent Registry, and Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center landed in parallel within 24 hours of the Anthropic + OpenAI registry launches; Mistral Workflows tenancy crossed 290 customers. Today Microsoft Skill Catalog adds Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop in public preview; AWS Bedrock Agent Registry adds OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop in private preview for FedRAMP-Moderate tenants; Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center extends model-card schema to include the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity attestation field. Mistral lands France's DGFiP for tax-return anomaly-detection routing, lifting tenancy to 296 and daily executions to 4.4M.

items.headline: Unsloth router-only LoRA gets community reproduction plus quantization-aware update
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reported 71-78% accuracy recovery across Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, and Kimi K2.6 at 8-13% training-step time and 11-16% peak VRAM, alongside recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth, Kimi K2.6, and Mixtral 8x22B. Today a Saturday Hacker News front-page write-up documents a successful end-to-end Kimi K2.6 router-only run on a single RTX 6000 Ada workstation reporting 14% peak VRAM and 76% accuracy recovery — within the published range. Unsloth ships a Saturday changelog adding a quantization-aware router-only LoRA mode targeting 4-bit dynamic-bits-per-parameter that trims peak VRAM by another 19% on Mixtral 8x22B and Llama 4 Behemoth, plus a Hugging Face PEFT compatibility shim for round-trip adapter export.

items.headline: Tenstorrent Galaxy first weekend shipments; AIwire publishes three-vendor roadmap reconciliation
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Tenstorrent announced general availability of the Wormhole Galaxy rack with first customers CoreWeave, Lambda Labs, Crusoe, and Hyundai's Robotics Metaplant, plus the IPO bridge close. Cerebras unveiled the CS-4 wafer-scale engine (71 PFLOPS dense BF16, Q1 2027 first samples). Today Tenstorrent confirms first production-rack shipments — CoreWeave 8, Lambda 6, Crusoe 4, Hyundai Metaplant 3 — with Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity joining as new investors in the closed bridge. AIwire publishes a Saturday three-vendor roadmap reconciliation table aligning Cerebras CS-4 Q1 2027, Nvidia Vera Rubin H1 2027, and AMD Helios H2 2026 capacity additions of materially comparable shape, with Tenstorrent Galaxy as the open-architecture fourth reference.

items.headline: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 first 12 of 240 active; Atlas commercial pilots advance
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday Tesla filed an 8-K confirming low-volume Optimus Gen 3 production at Fremont two months ahead of schedule (240 internal units plus 60 Stellantis Detroit pilot for late June), and Boston Dynamics announced the Atlas commercial roster across Hyundai Steel, Kia Zilina, and LG Energy Solution Holland. Today Tesla's Saturday operations note confirms the first 12 Gen 3 units have begun pilot work on the Fremont cell-pickup task within the human-baseline 1.4x cycle-time envelope. Hyundai Steel Dangjin's 60-unit pilot hits its first-week milestone with all units active; Kia Zilina reports a first complete shift cycle on paint-line A-pillar subassembly with no MTBF-impacting incidents; LG Holland Michigan is targeted for Monday activation. Hyundai Metaplant's 3-rack Tenstorrent allocation is now provisioned for the first per-task Atlas LoRA fine-tune Tuesday using the Unsloth router-only recipe.

items.headline: Verifiable per-tenant capability attestation arxiv lands as MCP governance proof
items.diff_narrative: Yesterday three new arxiv preprints extended the verifier-free process-reward, multi-agent cooperative search, and inference-routing threads, plus DeepMind's router-aware advantage decomposition paper directly relevant to Unsloth router-only. Today two new preprints land Saturday morning. Process-Reward-Free Reinforcement Learning for Math Reasoning at Scale (2605.05912) extends the verifier-free paradigm with a Llama 4 70B plus Qwen3.6-72B study reporting an additional 2.6-3.4% absolute gain when self-generated stepwise critiques are decomposed along a chain-of-verification structure. Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation for MCP Tool-Call Graphs (2605.05933) provides the formal-verification framework for the per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating shipped in Claude Code 3.0 plus the OpenAI per-org registry, proving a no-cross-tenant-information-leakage property. DeepMind separately ships a v2 supplemental ablation across the four MoE base models plus a JAX reference implementation pre-tested with the Unsloth recipes.
